**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement imposes no most-favoured-nation obligation on Corio. Pricing is fixed by reference to Exhibit B (Sections 4.1–4.2; Exhibit B Pricing and Revenue Sharing Fees), and there is no covenant requiring Corio to extend Commerce One terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, nor any right-to-match or best-offer mechanic. I checked the fee section, both pricing exhibits, payment terms, Grant of Rights, Shared Resources, Miscellaneous, and the (expressly non-binding) Exhibit D sales and marketing cooperation terms, and ran targeted searches for most-favoured/favourable-terms, matching, comparable-customer, lowest-price, discount and exclusivity language — no responsive obligation exists. No redline required.
